title: Binance Futures Will Launch USDⓈ-Margined CLANKERUSDT and BEATUSDT Perpetual Contracts (2025-11-12)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To expand the list of trading choices offered on Binance Futures and enhance users’ trading experience, Binance Futures will launch the following perpetual contract(s) as below: 2025-11-12 12:00 (UTC):  CLANKERUSDT  Perpetual Contract with up to 50x leverage 2025-11-12 12:15 (UTC):  BEATUSDT  Perpetual Contract with up to 40x leverage Please note that CLANKER ( LINK ) and BEAT ( LINK ) are already listed on Binance Alpha Market. More details on the aforementioned perpetual contract(s) can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract CLANKERUSDT BEATUSDT Launch Time 2025-11-12 12:00 (UTC) 2025-11-12 12:15 (UTC) Underlying Asset tokenbot (CLANKER) Audiera (BEAT) Contract Address 0x1bc0c42215582d5a085795f4badbac3ff36d1bcb 0xcf3232b85b43bca90e51d38cc06cc8bb8c8a3e36 Project Info Clanker is a token deployment framework, protocol, and AI-powered bot on Farcaster. Audiera is the Web3 evolution of the iconic (Audition) music and dance game IP. Settlement Asset USDT USDT Tick Size 0.01 0.00001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 50x 40x Trading Hours 24/7 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Supported Please Note:   The aforementioned perpetual contract(s) will be included in  Binance Futures New Listing Fee Promotion  campaign; The aforementioned perpetual contract(s) will be made available for Futures Copy Trading within 24 hours of launch. For more information on available Futures Copy Trading contracts, please refer to  this page . Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the aforementioned Futures contract(s) from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the aforementioned perpetual contract(s) across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the aforementioned perpetual contract(s).  The aforementioned perpetual contract(s) are subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement . Futures and spot token listings are  not correlated . A token listed on Binance Futures  does not guarantee  that it will be listed on Binance Spot.
